The cornerstone of the speed lies in the new driver that enables Xerox Streamnames to handle up to three scan engines simultaneously. It supports various common operating systems like Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X. The driver facilitates a configuration from a single user to multiple users based on the workgroup needs in large networks.
“Just one Xerox Streamname allows additional features that enable businesses to work faster and smarter,” said Antoanela Chiorean, senior marketing manager, Xerox Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
